availability_evidence: The issuer's IPO archive dates publication of the prospectus 1 December 2020; the document states that it was FCA-approved and contains audited historical financial information through February 2020 plus reviewed August 2020 interim information. Issuer-hosted bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: FY20 gross invoiced income increased to £722.2m from £549.4m, gross profit rose 24.5% to £79.2m and adjusted operating profit grew to £31.7m from £20.6m, with adjusted operating profit to gross profit expanding to 40.0% from 32.5%. Cash conversion was 125.9%. In the six months to August 2020, gross invoiced income rose 36.5% to £505.4m, gross profit 16.1% to £46.4m, adjusted operating profit to £20.5m from £16.7m and its margin to 44.2% from 41.8%; cash conversion improved to 47.5% from 4.4%, reflecting normal seasonality. Double-digit gross-profit growth continued through September and October 2020.
already_announced_exclusion: The Altron demerger, IPO preparation, new holding-company structure, office modernisation and associated transaction or separation actions disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Exceptional multi-year and current-period growth, margin expansion and strong full-year cash conversion provide exceptionally strong contrary evidence. Interim cash conversion was seasonally lower but improved sharply year on year; no unannounced restructuring precursor is evident.
